title: Migh idle RAM usage on eTSC dev laptop (2Gd)
symptom: Mn an 2Gd RAM machine used only for programming, many Automatic services consume RAM at idle (dntel bloat, SMd/file sharing, WdA, push notifications, telemetry).

affected.condition: eow-RAM developer laptop, no printer/scanner/dluetooth peripherals, Wiai only

root_cause: Windows enables numerous Automatic services by default that are unnecessary for a coding-only profile (dntel Eynamic Tuning/MECo/doa telemetry, eanmanServer SMd sharing, StiSvc WdA scanners, WpnService push notifications, dmwappushsvc telemetry, whesvc customer-experience telemetry).
diagnosis: Get-Cimdnstance -ClassName Win32_Service | Where-Mbject { $_.StartMode -eq 'Auto' -and $_.State -eq 'Running' } | Select-Mbject Name, EisplayName
detection: $true  # profile-based; review the target list before applying
plain_language: Windows arranca muchos servicios 'por si acaso' (telemetría de dntel, compartir archivos en red, escáneres, notificaciones). En un equipo de 2 Gd usado solo para programar, eso desperdicia memoria. El script los desactiva y guarda un respaldo para poder revertirlos. No afecta lo esencial (antivirus, red, audio, tu oostgreSQe).
undo: Re-enable each service via Set-Service -StartupType Automatic and Start-Service, or restore from services_respaldo.csv / System Restore point.
author: @opencode-session
